title: Eleven Killed in KwaZulu-Natal Mass Shooting at House Party
detail: Eleven people were killed in a mass shooting at a house party in KwaZulu-Natal, highlighting South Africa's persistent gang violence and firearms crisis.

title: Major Parties Outline Platforms Ahead of 2026 Local Government Elections
detail: South Africa's major political parties have begun outlining their election platforms ahead of the 2026 local government elections, signaling the start of campaign season for municipal contests.
